authority.convention: Use X_at_plasma_boundary for a local separatrix value and flux_surface_averaged_X_at_plasma_boundary for its surface average. Reclaim only when superseded intermediates lead to this identity, or the holder has a different DD locus from the tombstone and this identity.
authority.clarification: Follow superseded intermediates to the live tip; electron-temperature closes on the renaming name. Generated models are expected ignored provisioning.

argon_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Boundary-averaged number density of argon ions on the plasma boundary, represented by the last closed flux surface separating the magnetically confined plasma from the open-field-line scrape-off layer. Unless a charge state is specified separately, argon ions refers to all ionization stages combined.

argon_density_at_separatrix.description: Charge-state-summed number density of argon ions, excluding neutral argon, evaluated locally on the magnetic separatrix.

beryllium_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of beryllium ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all ionization states.

boron_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of boron at the plasma boundary, evaluated as the local, intensive particle count per physical volume on the last closed magnetic flux surface, summed over neutral atoms and all ionization states.

boron_density_flux_surface_averaged_at_p.description: Flux-surface-averaged number density of boron, including neutral atoms and all ionization states, evaluated on the plasma boundary.

bulk_electron_temperature_flux_surface_a.description: Flux-surface-averaged bulk electron temperature evaluated at the last closed flux surface.

carbon_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of carbon impurity ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all ionization states.

density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Particle number density of a selected plasma population evaluated at the plasma boundary, the last closed magnetic flux surface separating confined plasma from the scrape-off layer.

deuterium_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of deuterium ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface, summed over all ionic charge states, and excluding neutral deuterium.

deuterium_tritium_density_at_plasma_boun.description: Number density of the effective deuterium-tritium fuel pseudo-species at the plasma boundary, evaluated as the local, intensive particle count per physical volume on the last closed magnetic flux surface.

deuterium_tritium_density_flux_surface_a.description: Flux-surface-averaged number density of deuterium-tritium pseudo-species ions at the plasma boundary (separatrix).

effective_charge_at_plasma_boundary.description: Effective charge number of the ion mixture at the plasma boundary is the charge-squared-weighted sum of ionic number densities divided by the electron number density at that boundary. It equals one for a purely singly charged hydrogenic ion mixture and increases with impurity charge content.

effective_charge_at_separatrix.description: Local effective ionic charge of the plasma mixture at the separatrix, reflecting charge-squared weighting across all contributing ion species and charge states.

effective_charge_flux_surface_averaged_a.description: Flux-surface average of the ion-mixture effective charge over the entire plasma-boundary surface, distinct from the local boundary value.

electron_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of electrons at the plasma boundary, evaluated as the local, intensive particle count per physical volume on the last closed magnetic flux surface.

electron_pressure_at_plasma_boundary.description: Isotropic momentum-flux density of random electron motion evaluated on the last closed flux surface separating confined plasma from the scrape-off layer.

electron_pressure_at_separatrix.description: Local kinetic pressure carried by the electron population at the magnetic separatrix, marking the boundary between confined plasma and open-field-line scrape-off-layer plasma.

electron_temperature_at_plasma_boundary.description: Thermal energy of the bulk electron population at the plasma boundary expressed as a kinetic temperature, equal to two-thirds of the mean random electron kinetic energy per particle. The boundary value is evaluated on the last closed magnetic flux surface or separatrix.

electron_temperature_at_separatrix.description: Temperature of electrons at the separatrix measures their mean random kinetic energy relative to the local mean electron flow.

flux_surface_averaged_argon_density_at_p.description: Number density of argon ions averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface, summed over all argon ion charge states and excluding neutral argon.

flux_surface_averaged_beryllium_density_.description: Number density of beryllium ions averaged over the plasma boundary, summed over all ionization states and excluding neutral beryllium.

flux_surface_averaged_boron_density_at_p.description: Flux-surface-averaged number density of boron, including neutral atoms and all ionization states, evaluated on the plasma boundary.

flux_surface_averaged_bulk_electron_temp.description: Flux-surface-averaged bulk electron temperature evaluated at the last closed flux surface.

flux_surface_averaged_carbon_density_at_.description: Number density of carbon ions averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface at the plasma boundary, summed over all carbon ion charge states and excluding neutral carbon.

flux_surface_averaged_deuterium_density_.description: Number density of deuterium ions averaged over the plasma-boundary flux surface, summed over all deuterium ion charge states and excluding neutral deuterium.

flux_surface_averaged_deuterium_tritium_.description: Flux-surface-averaged number density of deuterium-tritium pseudo-species ions at the plasma boundary (separatrix).

flux_surface_averaged_effective_charge_a.description: Flux-surface average of the ion-mixture effective charge over the entire plasma-boundary surface, distinct from the local boundary value.

flux_surface_averaged_electron_density_a.description: Flux-surface-averaged electron number density at the plasma boundary, using inverse-magnitude poloidal-flux-gradient weighting rather than a pointwise value.

flux_surface_averaged_helium_3_density_a.description: Number density of helium-3 ions averaged over the plasma boundary, summed over all helium-3 ion charge states and excluding neutral helium-3.

flux_surface_averaged_helium_4_density_a.description: Number density of helium-4 ions averaged over the full plasma-boundary flux surface, summed over all ionic charge states and excluding neutral helium-4.

flux_surface_averaged_hydrogen_density_a.description: Number density of hydrogen ions averaged over the plasma-boundary flux surface, with all hydrogen ion charge states summed and neutral hydrogen excluded.

flux_surface_averaged_ion_density_at_pla.description: Number density of ions of a specified species at the plasma boundary, flux-surface averaged with inverse poloidal-flux-gradient weighting, summed over all charge states, and excluding neutral atoms and molecules.

flux_surface_averaged_iron_density_at_pl.description: Number density of iron ions averaged over the plasma-boundary flux surface, summed over all iron ion charge states and excluding neutral iron.

flux_surface_averaged_krypton_density_at.description: Charge-state-summed krypton ion number density averaged over the complete separatrix, distinguishing a flux-surface value from the local boundary value.

flux_surface_averaged_lithium_density_at.description: Number density of lithium ions averaged over the plasma-boundary flux surface, summed over all lithium ion charge states and excluding neutral lithium.

flux_surface_averaged_neon_density_at_pl.description: Number density of neon ions averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface, with all neon ion charge states summed and neutral neon excluded.

flux_surface_averaged_nitrogen_density_a.description: Number density of nitrogen ions averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface bounding the confined plasma, summed over all ion charge states and excluding neutral nitrogen.

flux_surface_averaged_normalized_toroida.description: Dimensionless toroidal-flux surface label evaluated on the last closed magnetic surface, serving as the outer reference for the normalized flux coordinate.

flux_surface_averaged_oxygen_density_at_.description: Number density of oxygen ions flux-surface-averaged at the plasma boundary, summed over all charged oxygen ionization states and excluding neutral oxygen.

flux_surface_averaged_parallel_electric_.description: Flux-surface average of the signed electric-field projection along the magnetic field, taken over the separatrix rather than at a single point.
Flux-surface average of the signed electric-field projection along the magnetic field, taken over the separatrix rather than at a single point.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_argon_vel.description: Flux-surface-averaged toroidal bulk-flow velocity of elemental argon ions at the plasma boundary, combining charge states through a density-weighted mean.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_beryllium.description: Density-weighted toroidal bulk-flow velocity of beryllium ions, flux-surface averaged at the plasma boundary over all populated charge states.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_carbon_ve.description: Density-weighted toroidal bulk-flow velocity of carbon impurity ions, averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface at the plasma boundary.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_deuterium.description: Density-weighted toroidal bulk-flow velocity of an effective deuterium–tritium fuel species, averaged over the last closed flux surface at the plasma boundary.

Flux-surface-averaged deuterium-ion bulk-flow velocity along increasing toroidal angle on the last closed magnetic surface in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, with ionization states density-weighted.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_helium_3_.description: Flux-surface-averaged toroidal velocity of helium-3 ions at the plasma boundary (separatrix).

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_helium_4_.description: Flux-surface-averaged toroidal bulk-flow velocity of helium-4 ions at the separatrix, density-weighted over all helium-4 charge states.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_hydrogen_.description: Density-weighted toroidal bulk-flow velocity of hydrogen ions, averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface and combining all ionization states.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_ion_veloc.description: Flux-surface-averaged toroidal bulk-flow velocity of the total ion fluid at the plasma boundary, representing the density-weighted mean over all ion species and charge states.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_iron_velo.description: Flux-surface-averaged toroidal component of the iron impurity ion bulk flow velocity at the plasma boundary (last closed flux surface).

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_krypton_v.description: Density-weighted toroidal bulk velocity of krypton ions, averaged over all ionization states and the last closed magnetic flux surface in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_lithium_v.description: Charge-state-aggregated toroidal bulk-flow velocity of lithium ions, averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface at the plasma boundary.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_neon_velo.description: Flux-surface average of the toroidal neon-ion bulk velocity on the last closed magnetic flux surface, with all ionization states combined by density weighting.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_nitrogen_.description: Flux-surface-averaged toroidal velocity of nitrogen ions at the plasma boundary (separatrix), with charge states combined by a density-weighted mean.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_oxygen_ve.description: Density-weighted, flux-surface-averaged toroidal bulk-flow velocity of oxygen impurity ions, combined over all ionization states on the last closed flux surface.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_total_pla.description: Flux-surface-averaged total plasma momentum in the toroidal direction at the plasma boundary is the signed flux-surface average, on the last closed magnetic flux surface, of the cumulative toroidal linear momentum enclosed by that surface, summed over electrons and all ion species. Positive values point along increasing toroidal angle φ in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_tritium_v.description: Density-weighted flux-surface average of the toroidal bulk-flow velocity of tritium ions on the last closed flux surface at the plasma boundary.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_tungsten_.description: The right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z)-frame toroidal component of the flux-surface-averaged tungsten ion bulk velocity at the plasma boundary is a density-weighted average, with the species velocity taken as the density-weighted mean over all ionization states.

flux_surface_averaged_toroidal_xenon_vel.description: Flux-surface-averaged toroidal component of xenon ion bulk flow velocity at the plasma boundary (last closed flux surface).

flux_surface_averaged_total_ion_density_.description: Flux-surface-averaged number density of all charged ion species at the plasma boundary, summed over charge states and excluding neutral particles.

flux_surface_averaged_tritium_density_at.description: Number density of tritium ions averaged over the plasma boundary, summed over all tritium ion charge states and excluding neutral tritium.

flux_surface_averaged_tungsten_density_a.description: Flux-surface-averaged number density of positively charged tungsten ions on the last closed magnetic flux surface, summed over all ionization states.

flux_surface_averaged_xenon_density_at_p.description: Number density of xenon ions averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface, summed over all xenon ion charge states and excluding neutral xenon.

helium_3_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of helium-3 ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated as the local particle count per physical volume on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over charge states.

helium_4_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of helium-4 ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all charge states.

hot_neutral_temperature_at_plasma_bounda.description: Energy-equivalent translational temperature of hot neutral atoms at the plasma boundary, characterizing their random motion after removal of bulk flow.

hydrogen_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of hydrogen ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all hydrogen ion charge states.

ion_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of charged ions at the plasma boundary, with each specialization defining whether the value is local or averaged over the last closed magnetic flux surface.

iron_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of iron impurity ions at the plasma boundary, the last closed flux surface separating the magnetically confined plasma from the open-field-line scrape-off layer, summed over all ion charge states from Fe+ through fully stripped Fe26+.

krypton_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of krypton ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated as the local, intensive particle count per physical volume on the last closed magnetic flux surface.

krypton_density_flux_surface_averaged_at.description: Charge-state-summed krypton ion number density averaged over the complete separatrix, distinguishing a flux-surface value from the local boundary value.

lithium_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of lithium ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all ionization states.

loop_voltage_at_plasma_boundary.description: Toroidal electromotive force evaluated on the last closed flux surface that drives the conventionally signed ohmic plasma current.

magnetic_shear_at_plasma_boundary.description: Magnetic shear evaluated at the plasma boundary, equal to the normalized logarithmic derivative of the safety factor with respect to normalized toroidal flux radius, flux-surface averaged over the separatrix.

neon_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of neon ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all ionization stages.

nitrogen_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of nitrogen ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated as the local, intensive particle count per physical volume on the last closed magnetic flux surface.

normalized_toroidal_flux_coordinate_at_p.description: Dimensionless toroidal-flux surface label evaluated on the last closed magnetic surface, serving as the outer reference for the normalized flux coordinate.

normalized_toroidal_flux_coordinate_at_s.description: Dimensionless toroidal-flux surface label at the magnetic separatrix, identifying the outermost closed magnetic surface and its outer normalization value.

oxygen_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of oxygen ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated as the local, intensive particle count per physical volume on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all charged oxygen ionization states.

parallel_electric_field_at_plasma_bounda.description: Signed projection of the local electric field along the local magnetic-field direction, evaluated at the last closed flux surface.

parallel_electric_field_at_separatrix.description: Parallel electric field at the separatrix is the electric field projected along the local magnetic field on the separatrix. It fixes the field-aligned projection and separatrix locus, while more specific names may add an aggregation over that locus.

poloidal_magnetic_flux_at_plasma_boundar.description: Signed poloidal magnetic flux evaluated on the last closed flux surface, providing the outer reference for normalized poloidal-flux coordinates.

radial_coordinate_of_plasma_boundary_gap.description: Major radius (R) coordinate of the reference point defining the gap between the plasma boundary and the wall.

radial_separatrix_distance_at_outboard_m.description: Signed major-radius separation between a measurement position mapped along its flux surface to the outboard midplane and the separatrix there; positive values are on the scrape-off-layer side.

safety_factor_at_plasma_boundary.description: Signed field-line winding ratio evaluated on the outermost closed magnetic flux surface, counting toroidal turns per poloidal circuit at the plasma boundary.

toroidal_argon_velocity_at_plasma_bounda.description: Toroidal component in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame of the argon-ion bulk-flow velocity at the last closed flux surface.

toroidal_carbon_velocity_at_plasma_bound.description: Density-weighted toroidal bulk-flow velocity of carbon impurity ions at the last closed magnetic flux surface, resolved along increasing toroidal angle.

toroidal_deuterium_tritium_velocity_at_p.description: Toroidal component of the bulk flow velocity of the fictitious deuterium-tritium single-species (atomic mass 2.5 amu), evaluated at the plasma boundary (last closed flux surface).

toroidal_deuterium_velocity_at_plasma_bo.description: Density-weighted toroidal bulk-flow velocity of deuterium ions at the last closed flux surface, resolved along increasing toroidal angle.

toroidal_flux_coordinate_at_plasma_bound.description: Dimensionful toroidal-flux radius labeling the outermost closed magnetic flux surface and setting the boundary value for this radial coordinate.

toroidal_helium_3_velocity_at_plasma_bou.description: Signed toroidal component of the helium-3 ion bulk-flow velocity evaluated on the plasma boundary, along the direction of increasing toroidal angle.

toroidal_helium_4_velocity_at_plasma_bou.description: Signed toroidal component of the bulk-flow velocity of helium-4 ions evaluated on the last closed magnetic flux surface.

toroidal_hydrogen_velocity_at_plasma_bou.description: Local toroidal component of the hydrogen-ion bulk-flow velocity at the plasma boundary, density-weighted over all hydrogen charge states.

toroidal_ion_velocity_at_plasma_boundary.description: Toroidal ion velocity at the plasma boundary is the toroidal component, in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, of the density-weighted bulk-flow velocity of the total ion fluid at the plasma boundary. It is distinct from random thermal motion and transport-model convection velocities.

toroidal_iron_velocity_at_plasma_boundar.description: Toroidal component of the bulk-flow velocity of iron impurity ions evaluated at the last closed flux surface in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

toroidal_krypton_velocity_at_plasma_boun.description: Toroidal component of the local bulk flow velocity of krypton impurity ions at the plasma boundary, projected along the φ direction of the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame. It is a density-weighted mean over all krypton ionization states represented in the plasma.

toroidal_magnetic_flux_at_plasma_boundar.description: Toroidal magnetic flux at the plasma boundary is the net flux of toroidal magnetic field through the poloidal cross-section enclosed by the plasma boundary, including externally imposed and plasma-poloidal-current contributions.

toroidal_neon_velocity_at_plasma_boundar.description: Toroidal neon velocity at the plasma boundary is the toroidal component of the density-weighted bulk velocity of neon impurity ions at the last closed flux surface, in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame. It is the density-weighted mean over all neon ion charge states and is local, not a flux-surface average.

toroidal_nitrogen_velocity_at_plasma_bou.description: Density-weighted toroidal bulk-flow velocity of nitrogen ions, evaluated on the last closed magnetic flux surface at the plasma boundary.

toroidal_oxygen_velocity_at_plasma_bound.description: Toroidal component of the oxygen impurity ion bulk flow velocity evaluated at the plasma boundary (last closed flux surface).

toroidal_total_plasma_momentum_flux_surf.description: Flux-surface-averaged total plasma momentum in the toroidal direction at the plasma boundary is the signed flux-surface average, on the last closed magnetic flux surface, of the cumulative toroidal linear momentum enclosed by that surface, summed over electrons and all ion species. Positive values point along increasing toroidal angle φ in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

toroidal_tritium_velocity_at_plasma_boun.description: Toroidal component of the tritium ion fluid velocity evaluated at the plasma boundary, the last closed flux surface separating the magnetically confined plasma from the open-field-line scrape-off layer.

toroidal_tungsten_velocity_at_plasma_bou.description: Toroidal component of the density-weighted bulk velocity of tungsten impurity ions at the last closed flux surface separating confined plasma from the scrape-off layer.

toroidal_xenon_velocity_at_plasma_bounda.description: Toroidal component of the xenon-ion bulk-flow velocity evaluated on the plasma boundary, the last closed flux surface.

total_ion_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Total ion number density at the plasma boundary is the local particle count per volume, summing all charged ion species and charge states while excluding neutrals.

total_power_at_separatrix.description: Net energy power leaving the confined plasma through the last closed magnetic flux surface and entering the scrape-off layer.

tritium_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of tritium ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated as the local, intensive particle count per physical volume on the last closed magnetic flux surface.

tungsten_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Separatrix-averaged number density of ionized tungsten at the plasma boundary, summed over charge states W1+ through W74+. Neutral tungsten atoms are excluded.

tungsten_density_at_separatrix.description: Tungsten-ion number density on the last closed magnetic flux surface, summed over all positive ionization states and distinguished from its flux-surface average.

tungsten_density_flux_surface_averaged_a.description: Flux-surface-averaged number density of positively charged tungsten ions on the last closed magnetic flux surface, summed over all ionization states.

xenon_density_at_plasma_boundary.description: Number density of xenon ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all ionization stages.
